pages.lesson:
LESSON: THOUGHTS AND FEELINGS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.2: Thoughts and feelings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Thoughts and feelings
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: why it is good to be joyful, 1. How do you control your thoughts and feelings?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify good thoughts and feelings
2. explain the importance of being joyful

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify good thoughts and feelings

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify good thoughts and feelings.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify good thoughts and feelings” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify good thoughts and feelings” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify good thoughts and feelings" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain the importance of being joyful

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the importance of being joyful.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the importance of being joyful” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the importance of being joyful” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the importance of being joyful" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify good thoughts and feelings
• Model 2: explain the importance of being joyful

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify good thoughts and feelings
2. Practise: explain the importance of being joyful

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Thoughts and feelings.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. why it is good to be joyful, 1. How do you control your thoughts and feelings?
2. How do you cope with anger or sadness?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify good thoughts and feelings
• explain the importance of being joyful

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
